verdict.rationale: Exa ships its own task-delegation agent. Exa Agent is an async research agent for list building, enrichment and deep research, returning grounded structured answers. Websets can also be run visually in the Dashboard with no code: give it a natural-language query and it searches, verifies and enriches results itself. Hands-on Websets reports of slow 'Verifying...' runs and many non-matching results show the delegation works but with uneven quality. Missing for 10: evidence of a conversational assistant embedded in the product UI (the agent is mainly an API/MCP surface), documentation of in-dashboard delegation beyond Websets, and reliable hands-on results.
